summary: Five skills that only loaded inside bydiorama/ui now ship in the `ui` plugin (ADR 0027): ui:design-component (designing a component in Paper against the system) and the demo-media set — ui:motion-media, ui:demo-page, ui:video-render and ui:stills-render, renamed from their ui- prefixed directories and carrying their render scripts and reference pages. griddy-icons-in-paper left this repo; its source is bydiorama/internal-skills (public in bydiorama/skills).
